preconditions.description: The integer n is within the bounds 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The input p is a permutation of length n, containing each integer from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(q) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in q) and len(set(q)) == n and all(p[i-1] == q[q[i-1]-1] for i in range(1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: If a valid permutation q exists such that q^2 = p, stdout contains q as a permutation of length n. Otherwise, stdout is '-1'.
